parameters.query: INSERT INTO queue_entries (appointment_id, patient_id, doctor_id, token, position, status) SELECT a.appointment_id, a.patient_id, a.doctor_id, a.token, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(position), 0) + 1 FROM queue_entries WHERE doctor_id = a.doctor_id AND status = 'WAITING'), 'WAITING' FROM appointments a WHERE a.appointment_id = $1 RETURNING *;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'ok', success: true, queue_id: $json.queue_id, position: $json.position, token: $json.token, appointment_id: $json.appointment_id } }}
={{ { status: 'error', success: false, error_code: $json.error_code || 'INVALID_QR', message: $json.message || 'QR code is invalid or expired' } }}
